verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one hands-on community report that Ollama's app has multimodal support that "works as expected." That points to image-plus-text understanding, but no first-party docs describe vision-language models, image inputs in the API, or supported VLMs. The image-generation blog post is a different capability (generation, not understanding) and is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of vision model support, API details for sending images alongside prompts, a list of supported vision-language models, and corroborated hands-on detail beyond a single brief mention.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
